payload.blocks: Whether plans 261125-2041 (gather rules) and 261122-1946 (agent start context) stay done. Nothing else waits on it.
payload.headline: Two plans are done except the full gate, red only by failures that predate them

parts.cause: Each of those failures also fails on f68937f41, main before tonight's lands (recorded in both plan.md files). None touches either plan's files, and each phase's own rule is to fix nothing outside its footprint. Every failure these plans caused was fixed before closing.

options.does: Leave the status; the baseline evidence stays in each plan.md.
options.gain: Plans that depend on them can go on; the record is accurate.
options.harm: The criterion is met in substance, not to the letter.
options.label: A: keep both done

options.cost: Waits on herdr, fgctl, credential and workflow lanes.
options.does: Set both plans back to running until the owning lanes fix those failures.
options.gain: The letter of the criterion holds.
options.harm: Blocks any plan that waits on them, for failures they did not cause.
options.label: B: reopen until green

options.does: Open a plan that fixes the listed failures across their lanes.
options.harm: Touches several lanes' code; may collide with work on fg-server2.
options.label: C: one plan fixes the red

parts.recommendation: A, and C as its own backlog item if a green gate on main matters now.

scope.allows: The status of these two plans, and whether to open a fix plan.

parts.what: Both plans finished every phase and are marked done on main. Their criteria also say npm test and cargo test --workspace are green on the merged tree. The gate is still red: herdr terminal-cutover and crash-matrix, fgctl-upgrade and init-download, bwrap credential sources, guide-schema, and two fgos-run-supervisor head-request tests.
